name: Awakening: choosing a System explains its first quest and its own penalty

planSteps.description: Open the app at / and wait up to 30 seconds for a black screen with the text 'TOUCH TO ESTABLISH CONTACT' (a Flutter web app; it can take a while to load, and controls are exposed in the accessibility tree)
Wait 6 seconds while the emblem forms and the '[ NOTIFICATION ]' window types its message
Click 'ACCEPT' once (this test build accepts a click in place of the hold)
On the 'CHOOSE YOUR SYSTEM' screen, click the small diamond button named 'Show the Personality System' under the card, then wait 1 second
Click the front card (the button named 'Personality System') once to flip it, then wait 1 second

The card now shows '[ PERSONALITY · BRIEF ]', a 'WHERE YOU START' list containing 'Read (pages)' with '10', and an 'IF YOU FAIL A DAY' section mentioning '20 pages and a plan for tomorrow' and no push-ups; the button at the bottom reads 'CHOOSE PERSONALITY SYSTEM'
If the front card shows 'TAP TO INSPECT', click it once (the button named 'Focus System') and wait 1 second
The card shows '[ FOCUS · BRIEF ]' and its 'IF YOU FAIL A DAY' section mentions 'a 60-minute phone-free block'; the button reads 'CHOOSE FOCUS SYSTEM'
